question_sentence: Which state recently elected its first Black US senator since Reconstruction?
evidence: Scott Colom will become Mississippi’s first Democratic senator in over four decades and the first Black person elected to statewide office in Mississippi since the Reconstruction era.

question_sentence: Which New York City borough saw a deadly building collapse this week?
evidence: At least eight people were killed in a three-story building collapse in Brooklyn, New York, on Wednesday, authorities said. The cause of the incident is still under investigation.

question_sentence: The US marked Veterans Day this week. Which war did the holiday originally commemorate?
evidence: Veterans Day, a holiday honoring men and women who have served in the US armed forces, is observed annually on November 11. The holiday was originally known as Armistice Day and marked the end of fighting in World War I in 1918.

question_sentence: Which European country saw millions of people join a general strike this week over housing concerns?
evidence: Around four million Spaniards took part in a general strike on Wednesday, unions said, as anger over housing continues to mount.

question_sentence: Pete Hegseth dodged impeachment this week. What is his role in the Trump administration?

evidence: House GOP leaders successfully killed a push to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in a surprising show of unity from the Republican Party following the results of the midterms.

question_sentence: Around how many women are expected to serve in the next US Congress?
evidence: A record number of women are set to serve in the next Congress, with at least 159 from both parties elected to the House and Senate. The figure could rise as remaining races are decided.
